:::{#thm-nested-re-cov}
#### Covariances in the two-level nested model

Under @def-nested-re:

$$
\Cov{Y_{ijk}, Y_{i'j'k'}} =
\begin{cases}
\sigma_L^2 + \sigma_B^2 + \sigma^2 & \text{if } (i', j', k') = (i, j, k)
\\
\sigma_L^2 + \sigma_B^2 & \text{if } i' = i,\ j' = j,\ k' \ne k
\\
\sigma_L^2 & \text{if } i' = i,\ j' \ne j
\\
0 & \text{if } i' \ne i
\end{cases}
$$ {#eq-nested-re-cov}
:::
